text: The customer reported a duplicate charge of ₹1,299 on 12 November on their card ending in 4417 and wants the extra charge refunded. The agent confirmed the duplicate charge and raised a reversal with the payment partner under reference RV-220918, which takes 3–5 working days to clear. Next, we need to monitor the reversal and ensure the funds are credited before 20 November, when the customer plans to file a dispute with their bank.
